name: 3D Tract Surfaces
summary: Converts binary tract masks (NIfTI) into smoothed 3D surface meshes with VTK marching cubes, writing one .vtk, .ply or .stl surface per tract.
description: Each *.nii.gz mask in the input directory is turned into a triangular mesh with vtkDiscreteMarchingCubes and smoothed with a windowed-sinc filter for the chosen number of iterations; a color.json in the input is copied through. Use it to visualise tracts in 3D or as input to surface shape analysis; choose vtk output for other brainlife Apps. The job fails if the number of surfaces does not match the number of masks.

inputs.description: binary masks are converted to 3D triangular surfaces

outputs.description: 3D surface for each binary volume input

parameters.description: Choose the number of times you would like each tract to be smoothed. Smoothing makes the surfaces less blocky.

citations.text: Kitchell L. Shape Analysis of Human White Matter Tracts: An Examination of Normal Morphological Variability and the Association Between Morphology, Brain Size, and Behavior. Indiana University (2020).

failure_modes.cause: Fewer surfaces were written than input mask files.
failure_modes.fix: Check that every mask is a valid non-empty binary NIfTI.
